name: dependency-upgrade-compliant
description: Upgrade only the packages the host fetched: plan, approve with existing debt accepted, execute, verify, security gate passes. Plan granularity is not asserted: a single well-formed task must also pass.

steps.name: ask about vulnerabilities
steps.say: 这个项目的 NuGet 依赖有没有已知的安全漏洞？有的话给我一个升级方案，哪些能直接升，哪些要我拍板。先别改代码。

steps.name: plan
steps.say: SharpCompress 先不动。其余有漏洞的包全部升级，只升到简报里宿主已取包的目标版本，别的包都不要动。给我一份正式计划（走 create_session_plan），我看过再批准，先别执行。

steps.name: approve and execute
steps.say: 计划我看过了，批准，开始执行。
